chapter: Instruments, tenors and the current band
title: Everyone plays flugelhorn; Dusko Goykovich
summary: Today every trumpeter plays flugelhorn. Dusko Goykovich was an early such player and wrote I Remember Clifford and Woody's Whistle.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Cornet or trumpet: choosing and owning horns

blocks.x: Yeah. Maybe we just remain in that bag for a minute? You've had all the people from Joe Bishop on up, using a fluegelhorn very early, to the first or second Herd we talked about. But in between, you had some dynamite people as well, I think, that were sitting in those chairs, all kinds of people.
Well, I think the difference in the approach and the whole attitude of my big band today is that everybody plays fluegelhorn. Every trumpet player --
Yeah, yeah. You had that Yugoslavian, Goykovich. Dusko Gleicovitch (PHONETIC).
Yeah, he was one of the first players.
In that period, yeah. Yeah, he was very good.
Yeah. "I remember Clifford," when he did that.
Yeah, and you remember Woody's Whistle?"
"Red Roses For a Blue Lady." And he showed his versatility, right?
Right. He's very active in -- you bump into him occasionally.
And he's very hip in Germany.
